content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Owns billboards, broadband and insurance businesses; it sells ad space and insurance, not agency creative or media-buying services."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Customer experience outsourcing and tech services run contact centers, unlike Omnicom's creative and marketing agency work."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Economic and litigation consulting for law firms and regulators, a different service with no marketing or advertising overlap."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Insurance claims management and adjusting for insurers and employers, a different business from marketing and advertising."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Software engineering and IT consulting for enterprises, a technology services business rather than marketing services."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Research subscriptions, advisory and conferences for technology leaders, not creative, media or marketing agency services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Digital engineering and software development for retailers and banks, a technology build business rather than marketing agency work."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Healthcare, education and commercial consulting plus revenue cycle outsourcing, a consulting and operations business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, construction and government infrastructure services, a project-based professional services business unrelated to advertising."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Owns and sells out-of-home ad displays as a media property; it sells inventory rather than providing agency creative and media services."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Agency network selling advertising, PR, digital marketing and media buying on fees and commissions to brand owners, like Omnicom."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced customer support, trust and safety and AI data labeling, an operations outsourcing business rather than marketing agency work."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage placing carrier coverage for commissions, a financial intermediary business unrelated to marketing services."}]}
